claim: Add a dangling-deps check to mix cb.verify.schema: every dep of every active belief must resolve to an existing node (in-graph or via a declared cross-namespace dependency). The grounding check today verifies deps are non-empty, not that they resolve, so a dep pointing at a nonexistent id passes all checks silently.

evidence.detail: Observed live: after the bare-id import, deps written as cb:b484 pointed at a node stored as b484; 19 of 19 applicable schema checks passed and the dangle surfaced only because mix bs tree happened to be run. A resolution check would have caught it at verify time.

Retro-pair per the b507 close protocol: the session slug this node stipulates from is readable in the thread record - the schema-landing main body and postscripts 2-6 cover the stasis, observability, and ceremony exchanges where these stipulations were made.

todos.action: Add a dep-resolution check to mix cb.verify.schema: every dep of every active belief resolves in-collection; deps in namespaces the collection's ids never use defer to verify.collection's union check; bare deps are never cross-namespace
Cover dep resolution: resolving dep, dangling local dep, bare-dep incident replay, cross-namespace deferral, and non-active exemption
